Use case: stylized-concept
Create a polished hand-painted anime adventure game harbor panorama, wide landscape 1536×1024, for SHIOGAERI. A BRIGHT inviting Japanese-inspired coastal recovery town during a sunny break in weather: sparkling clear turquoise sea, pale limestone quays and steps, white stucco buildings with coral tile roofs, honey-colored timber docks, teal canvas awnings, a cream lighthouse on the distant headland, fishing boats with ropes and nets, small bright flowers in planters, gulls, foamy waves. Old flooded alleys and ruins still suggest salvage adventures, but sunlight and warm human life dominate. Carefully layered environment with rich crafted architecture, purposeful visual storytelling, confident beautiful anime-adventure background painting, clean readable silhouettes, simplified luminous material planes, selective fine ink outlines and painterly gouache texture. Upper-left warm afternoon sunlight, blue open sky with luminous cream clouds, rich teal shadow without black or gray wash. Sophisticated color harmony: turquoise, pale warm cream, coral, honey gold. Open water and pale sky provide breathing room; dense charming town fills middle distance. Composition works behind native title UI, no baked UI. Avoid gloomy nighttime, monochrome ruins, photorealism, generic 3D, pixel art, overbusy scratch texture. NO letters, words, logos, watermark, frames, borders, UI or characters close to camera.
